WITH date_series AS (
    -- Generate a series of all dates between $__timeFrom() and $__timeTo()
    SELECT generate_series(
        $__timeFrom()::date,  -- Start of the time filter
        $__timeTo()::date,    -- End of the time filter
        '1 day'::interval
    )::date AS date
),
daily_readings AS (
    -- Fetch daily power meter readings from the database
    SELECT
        DATE(datetime) AS date,
        CASE
            WHEN reset_value != 0 THEN 
                reset_value
            ELSE
                daily_power
        END AS daily_power
    FROM
        user_powermeterreadingdata
    WHERE
        form_id = 90  -- Filter by form_id
        AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
),
daily_consumption AS (
    -- Calculate daily consumption by subtracting the current reading from the next day's reading
    SELECT
        ds.date,
        CASE
            -- WHEN dr.daily_power = 0 THEN NULL
            -- ELSE COALESCE(dr.daily_power, 0) 
            WHEN dr.daily_power IS NOT NULL AND dr.daily_power > 0 THEN dr.daily_power
            ELSE NULL
        END AS daily_consumption
    FROM
        date_series ds
    LEFT JOIN 
        daily_readings dr ON ds.date = dr.date  -- Join with the actual daily readings
    WHERE
        $__timeFilter(ds.date)
        AND ds.date >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamp) 
        AND ds.date < CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)
)
SELECT
    date,  -- The date from the generated series
    SUM(daily_consumption)
FROM
    daily_consumption
GROUP BY
    date
ORDER BY
    date;

WITH date_series AS (
  SELECT
    GENERATE_SERIES(
      $__timeFrom() :: date,
      $__timeTo() :: date,
      '1 day' :: interval
    ) :: date AS date
),
inlet_data AS (
  SELECT
    datetime :: date AS date,
    CASE
      WHEN reset_value != 0 THEN 
          reset_value
      ELSE
          daily_flow
    END AS "Daily Inlet Flow",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY datetime :: date
      ORDER BY
        datetime DESC
    ) AS row_num
  FROM
    user_flowmeterreadingdata
  WHERE
    form_id = 93
    AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
    AND datetime >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamp)
    AND datetime < CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)
),
filtered_inlet_data AS (
  SELECT
    date,
    COALESCE("Daily Inlet Flow", 0) AS "Daily Inlet Flow"
  FROM
    inlet_data
  WHERE
    row_num = 1 -- Select only the latest reading for each date
),
inlet_with_next AS (
  SELECT
    ds.date,
    COALESCE(fid."Daily Inlet Flow", 0) AS "Daily Inlet Flow"
  FROM
    date_series ds
    LEFT JOIN filtered_inlet_data fid ON ds.date = fid.date
)
SELECT
  date AS date,
  CASE
        WHEN "Daily Inlet Flow" > 0 THEN 
            ("Daily Inlet Flow")
        ELSE 
            NULL
    END AS "Daily Inlet Flow"
FROM
  inlet_with_next
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(date)
  AND date >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamp)
  AND date < CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)
ORDER BY
  date;

        daily_readings dr ON ds.date = dr.date  -- Join with the actual daily readings
    WHERE
        $__timeFilter(ds.date)
        AND ds.date >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamp) 
        AND ds.date < CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)
)
SELECT

    SUM(daily_consumption)
FROM

GROUP BY

WITH date_series AS (
    -- Generate a series of all dates between $__timeFrom() and $__timeTo()
    SELECT generate_series(
        $__timeFrom()::date,  -- Start of the time filter
        $__timeTo()::date,    -- End of the time filter
        '1 day'::interval
    )::date AS date
),
daily_readings AS (
    -- Fetch daily power meter readings from the database
    SELECT
        DATE(datetime) AS date,
        CASE
            WHEN reset_value != 0 THEN 
                reset_value
            ELSE
                daily_power
        END AS daily_power
    FROM
        user_powermeterreadingdata
    WHERE
        form_id = 263  -- Filter by form_id
        AND $__timeFilter(datetime)
),
daily_consumption AS (
    -- Calculate daily consumption by subtracting the current reading from the next day's reading
    SELECT
        ds.date,
        CASE
            WHEN dr.daily_power <= 0 THEN 0
            ELSE COALESCE(dr.daily_power, 0) 
        END AS daily_consumption
    FROM
        date_series ds
    LEFT JOIN 
        daily_readings dr ON ds.date = dr.date  -- Join with the actual daily readings
    WHERE
        $__timeFilter(ds.date)
        AND ds.date >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamp) 
        AND ds.date < CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)
)
SELECT
    date,  -- The date from the generated series
    SUM(daily_consumption)
FROM
    daily_consumption
GROUP BY
    date
ORDER BY
    date;

WITH FirstValues AS (
  SELECT 
    is_aeration_tank_foaming,
    is_biomass_smell,
    is_suspended_solid_clarifier_outlet_water,
    is_solid_floating,
    date AS first_date
  FROM 
    user_dailycheckdata
  WHERE 
    form_id = 182
  AND
    "date" >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamp) 
  AND 
    "date" < CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)
  ORDER BY 
    date DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
LastChanges AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN ud.is_aeration_tank_foaming != fv.is_aeration_tank_foaming THEN ud.date END) AS last_change_date_foaming,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ud.is_biomass_smell != fv.is_biomass_smell THEN ud.date END) AS last_change_date_biomass_smell,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ud.is_suspended_solid_clarifier_outlet_water != fv.is_suspended_solid_clarifier_outlet_water THEN ud.date END) AS last_change_date_suspended_solid_clarifier_outlet_water,
    MAX(CASE WHEN ud.is_solid_floating != fv.is_solid_floating THEN ud.date END) AS last_change_date_solid_floating
  FROM 
    user_dailycheckdata ud
  CROSS JOIN 
    FirstValues fv
  WHERE 
    ud.form_id = 182
  AND
    "date" >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamp) 
  AND 
    "date" < CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)
),
LastRecord AS (
  SELECT ud.date AS last_record_date
  FROM user_dailycheckdata ud
  WHERE ud.form_id = 182
  AND 
    "date" >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamp) 
  AND 
    "date" < CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)
  ORDER BY ud.date ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
DefaultValues AS (
  SELECT 
    'All Equipments are healthy' AS is_aeration_tank_foaming,
    'All Equipments are healthy' AS is_biomass_smell,
    'All Equipments are healthy' AS is_suspended_solid_clarifier_outlet_water,
    'All Equipments are healthy' AS is_solid_floating,
    NOW() AS first_date -- Default timestamp
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FirstValues) = 0 THEN '🟢 All Equipments are Healthy'
    ELSE 
      CONCAT(
        CASE
          WHEN lc.last_change_date_foaming IS NULL THEN 
            EXTRACT(DAY FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lr.last_record_date)) +
            EXTRACT(MONTH FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lr.last_record_date)) * 30 +
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lr.last_record_date)) * 365
          ELSE 
            EXTRACT(DAY FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lc.last_change_date_foaming)) +
            EXTRACT(MONTH FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lc.last_change_date_foaming)) * 30 +
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lc.last_change_date_foaming)) * 365
        END,
        ' days - ',
        CASE 
          WHEN fv.is_aeration_tank_foaming = 'Yes' THEN 'Unhealthy'
          ELSE 'Healthy'
        END
      )
  END AS "Aeration Tank Foaming",

  CASE 
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FirstValues) = 0 THEN '🟢 All Equipments are Healthy'
    ELSE 
      CONCAT(
        CASE
          WHEN lc.last_change_date_biomass_smell IS NULL THEN 
            EXTRACT(DAY FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lr.last_record_date)) +
            EXTRACT(MONTH FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lr.last_record_date)) * 30 +
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lr.last_record_date)) * 365
          ELSE 
            EXTRACT(DAY FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lc.last_change_date_biomass_smell)) +
            EXTRACT(MONTH FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lc.last_change_date_biomass_smell)) * 30 +
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lc.last_change_date_biomass_smell)) * 365
        END,
        ' days - ',
        CASE 
          WHEN fv.is_biomass_smell = 'Yes' THEN 'Unhealthy'
          ELSE 'Healthy'
        END
      )
  END AS "Biomass Smell",

  CASE 
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FirstValues) = 0 THEN '🟢 All Equipments are Healthy'
    ELSE 
      CONCAT(
        CASE
          WHEN lc.last_change_date_suspended_solid_clarifier_outlet_water IS NULL THEN 
            EXTRACT(DAY FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lr.last_record_date)) +
            EXTRACT(MONTH FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lr.last_record_date)) * 30 +
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lr.last_record_date)) * 365
          ELSE 
            EXTRACT(DAY FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lc.last_change_date_suspended_solid_clarifier_outlet_water)) +
            EXTRACT(MONTH FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lc.last_change_date_suspended_solid_clarifier_outlet_water)) * 30 +
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lc.last_change_date_suspended_solid_clarifier_outlet_water)) * 365
        END,
        ' days - ',
        CASE 
          WHEN fv.is_suspended_solid_clarifier_outlet_water = 'Yes' THEN 'Unhealthy'
          ELSE 'Healthy'
        END
      )
  END AS "Suspended Solids Clarifier Outlet Water",

  CASE 
    WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FirstValues) = 0 THEN '🟢 All Equipments are Healthy'
    ELSE 
      CONCAT(
        CASE
          WHEN lc.last_change_date_solid_floating IS NULL THEN 
            EXTRACT(DAY FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lr.last_record_date)) +
            EXTRACT(MONTH FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lr.last_record_date)) * 30 +
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lr.last_record_date)) * 365
          ELSE 
            EXTRACT(DAY FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lc.last_change_date_solid_floating)) +
            EXTRACT(MONTH FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lc.last_change_date_solid_floating)) * 30 +
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(fv.first_date, lc.last_change_date_solid_floating)) * 365
        END,
        ' days - ',
        CASE 
          WHEN fv.is_solid_floating = 'Yes' THEN 'Unhealthy'
          ELSE 'Healthy'
        END
      )
  END AS "Solids Floating",

  COALESCE(
    lc.last_change_date_foaming, 
    lr.last_record_date,
    NOW() -- Default timestamp if no changes or records exist
  ) AS "time_field"  -- This is the time field Grafana needs to render

FROM 
  FirstValues fv
FULL OUTER JOIN 
  LastChanges lc ON true
FULL OUTER JOIN 
  LastRecord lr ON true
FULL OUTER JOIN 
  DefaultValues dv ON true
WHERE
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FirstValues) > 0 OR (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DefaultValues) > 0
  AND (
      fv.is_aeration_tank_foaming IS NOT NULL OR
      fv.is_biomass_smell IS NOT NULL OR
      fv.is_suspended_solid_clarifier_outlet_water IS NOT NULL OR
      fv.is_solid_floating IS NOT NULL
  ) -- Filter out records where equipment status is NULL

-- Handling case when no data is returned
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  '🟢 All Equipments are Healthy' AS "Aeration Tank Foaming",
  '🟢 All Equipments are Healthy' AS "Biomass Smell",
  '🟢 All Equipments are Healthy' AS "Suspended Solids Clarifier Outlet Water",
  '🟢 All Equipments are Healthy' AS "Solids Floating",
  NOW() AS "time_field"  -- Fallback timestamp if no data exists

WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_dailycheckdata WHERE form_id = 182 AND $__timeFilter(date))

ORDER BY "time_field" DESC;

SELECT
    equipment AS "Equipment",
    
    CASE
        WHEN electrical_issues IS NULL OR COALESCE(array_length(electrical_issues, 1), 0) = 0 THEN
            'No Issue'
        ELSE
            array_to_string(electrical_issues, ', ') 
    END AS "Electrical Issues",
    
    CASE
        WHEN mechanical_issues IS NULL OR COALESCE(array_length(mechanical_issues, 1), 0) = 0 THEN
            'No Issue'
        ELSE
            array_to_string(mechanical_issues, ', ') 
    END AS "Mechanical Issues",

    CASE
        WHEN e_and_i_issues IS NULL OR COALESCE(array_length(e_and_i_issues, 1), 0) = 0 THEN
            'No Issue'
        ELSE
            array_to_string(e_and_i_issues, ', ') 
    END AS "E&I Issues",
    
    CASE
        WHEN description IS NULL OR description = '' THEN
            'No Issue'
        ELSE
            description
    END AS "Other Issues"
    
FROM
    user_maintenancedata
WHERE
    form_id = 96
    AND status = 'Breakdown'
ORDER BY
    time_of_data_entry DESC;

SELECT
    equipment AS "Equipment",
    end_time AS "Resolved Time",

    CASE
        WHEN electrical_issues IS NULL OR COALESCE(array_length(electrical_issues, 1), 0) = 0 THEN
            'No Issue'
        ELSE
            array_to_string(electrical_issues, ', ') 
    END AS "Electrical Issues",
    
    CASE
        WHEN mechanical_issues IS NULL OR COALESCE(array_length(mechanical_issues, 1), 0) = 0 THEN
            'No Issue'
        ELSE
            array_to_string(mechanical_issues, ', ') 
    END AS "Mechanical Issues",

    CASE
        WHEN e_and_i_issues IS NULL OR COALESCE(array_length(e_and_i_issues, 1), 0) = 0 THEN
            'No Issue'
        ELSE
            array_to_string(e_and_i_issues, ', ') 
    END AS "E&I Issues",
    
    CASE
        WHEN description IS NULL OR description = '' THEN
            'No Issue'
        ELSE
            description
    END AS "Other Issues",

    CASE
        WHEN consumable IS NULL OR consumable = '' THEN
            '-'
        ELSE
            consumable
    END AS "Consumable Used"
    
FROM
    user_maintenancedata
WHERE
    form_id = 96
    AND status = 'Resolved'
    AND $__timeFilter(end_time) 
ORDER BY
    end_time DESC;
